ROW.COLUMN: (ML/CU) Routing of Funds Through Multiple Locations

This scenario targets one of the typical behaviors of the placement stage of money laundering, where illegally obtained money from various sources is collected at one place and then disbursed for the purpose of layering. The scenario monitors the activity where funds are funneled through a number of legs, and associated geographies by a customer in an attempt to hide the true origin and destination. For the purposes of this scenario, "location" is considered as: - City - State - Country
